description: Final consolidation: family identity summary, evidence matrix, GO decision table, comparison table and five-panel summary figure
code:
import os, json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUT=os.getcwd()
r=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"identity_to_mec14_full.csv"))
def fam(k):
    if k.startswith("MEC14") or k.startswith("Cel_"): return "nematode AKR / MEC-14 clade"
    if k.startswith("AKR6") or k=="AKR6_Hk_Dmel": return "AKR6 (Kv beta subunits)"
    if k.startswith("AKR7"): return "AKR7"
    if "LGalDH" in k: return "L-GalDH (EC 1.1.1.316)"
    if k.startswith("AKR1A") or k.startswith("AKR1B") or k.startswith("AKR1C") or k.startswith("AKR1D") or k.startswith("AKR1E"):
        return "AKR1 (human/rat)"
    return "bacterial / fungal / plant AKR"
r["family"]=r.protein.map(fam)
fs=r.groupby("family").pid.agg(best="max",mean="mean",n="count").sort_values("best",ascending=False).round(1)
fs.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"family_identity_summary.csv"))
print(fs.to_string())
gap=r[r.family=="L-GalDH (EC 1.1.1.316)"].pid.max()-r[~r.family.isin(["L-GalDH (EC 1.1.1.316)","nematode AKR / MEC-14 clade"])].pid.max()
print(f"\nL-GalDH leads the next-best characterised non-nematode AKR by {gap:.1f} percentage points")

# ---------- artifact tables ----------
ev=pd.DataFrame([
 dict(id="E1",citation="This run (computed)",evidence_type="structural/computational",stance="qualifies",
      claim="MEC-14 retains the AKR catalytic tetrad",
      finding="Asp132-Lys163 2.70 A and Lys163-Tyr137 2.90 A match 1US0 (2.66, 3.11 A); the fourth position is Gln204 at 5.08 A from Tyr137 OH versus 3.70 A for AKR1B1 His110",
      context="AlphaFold Q20127 vs PDB 1US0 chain A, 1QRQ chain A",
      confidence="high for the three-residue relay (pLDDT 90-98); the Gln204 rotamer is a model, not a crystal structure"),
 dict(id="E2",citation="This run (computed)",evidence_type="structural/computational",stance="refutes",
      claim="The fourth tetrad position is His206",
      finding="Superposition onto AF L-GalDH (228 CA, 1.01 A RMSD) places Gln204 at the His124 site (tip 0.93 A); His206 is 5.76 A away, pLDDT 70",
      context="AlphaFold Q20127 vs AlphaFold O81884",
      confidence="high; method does not depend on the sequence alignment"),
 dict(id="E3",citation="This run (computed)",evidence_type="structural/computational",stance="qualifies",
      claim="MEC-14 binds NADPH",
      finding="Nicotinamide pocket is open (25 residues within 4.0 A of transferred NADP+, 3 clashes <2.0 A), but the 2'-phosphate site Lys262/Ser263/Arg268 of AKR1B1 maps to Asp354/Ser355/Gln358, a charge reversal shared with NAD+-dependent L-GalDH and with Kvbeta2",
      context="NADP+ from 1US0, NADPH from 1QRQ, transferred by Kabsch superposition",
      confidence="medium-high; predicts NAD(H) over NADPH, untested by assay"),
 dict(id="E4",citation="This run (computed)",evidence_type="structural/computational",stance="refutes",
      claim="MEC-14 substrate pocket resembles a characterised AKR",
      finding="Only 2 of 11 structurally matched AKR1B1 pocket residues keep type; aromatic lining 8/15 to 3/11; the C-terminal specificity loop Cys298-Tyr309 has no counterpart",
      context="IDD594 (LDT) contacts in 1US0 chain A mapped onto AF Q20127",
      confidence="high for loss of the AKR1B1 pocket; silent on what MEC-14 does bind"),
 dict(id="E5",citation="This run (computed)",evidence_type="evolutionary/computational",stance="supports",
      claim="MEC-14 belongs to a specific AKR subfamily",
      finding="Closest characterised relative is Arabidopsis L-galactose dehydrogenase at 42.4% identity over PF00248; next best characterised protein is Drosophila Hyperkinetic at 31.5%; human Kvbeta2 27.1%; AKR1B1 23.2%",
      context="41-member AKR panel, PF00248-trimmed global alignment, BLOSUM62 affine gap",
      confidence="high; an 11-point margin over the next best"),
 dict(id="E6",citation="This run (computed)",evidence_type="evolutionary/computational",stance="supports",
      claim="The non-canonical site is a fixed family feature, not degeneration",
      finding="In 19 nematode orthologs (54.5-96.0% identity) Asp132 and Tyr137 are 100% conserved, Lys163 84.2%, Gln204 94.7%; no ortholog restores His at 204",
      context="UniRef50 cluster of Q20127; Caenorhabditis, Pristionchus, Haemonchus, Steinernema, Mesorhabditis",
      confidence="high"),
 dict(id="E7",citation="PMID 8692859",evidence_type="mutant phenotype",stance="competing",
      claim="MEC-14 has a touch-neuron function",
      finding="mec-14 is required for touch sensitivity in C. elegans; no biochemical activity reported",
      context="C. elegans touch receptor neurons",
      confidence="phenotype only; gives no information on catalysis"),
 dict(id="E8",citation="PMID 12604248",evidence_type="review/database",stance="qualifies",
      claim="AKR nomenclature requires a measured function",
      finding="AKR superfamily assignment and family numbering are tied to characterised activity; uncharacterised relatives are not assigned",
      context="AKR superfamily nomenclature",
      confidence="review-level orientation"),
 dict(id="E9",citation="This run (database)",evidence_type="review/database",stance="supports",
      claim="Domain assignment",
      finding="InterPro/CDD assign MEC-14 to cd19163 (L-GalDH-like) rather than cd19141 (Kvbeta/AKR6A); PF00248 spans residues 97-373 of 453",
      context="InterPro API, accession Q20127",
      confidence="database-level, consistent with E5"),
])
ev.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"evidence_matrix.csv"),index=False)

go=pd.DataFrame([
 dict(aspect="MF",term="oxidoreductase activity, acting on the CH-OH group of donors, NAD or NADP as acceptor (GO:0016616)",
      current_status="candidate",lead="do not assert",rationale="fourth catalytic position is Gln204, substrate pocket not conserved, no assay"),
 dict(aspect="MF",term="aldo-keto reductase (NADP) activity (GO:0004033)",
      current_status="candidate",lead="remove or do not add",rationale="2'-phosphate site is charge-reversed (Asp354/Ser355/Gln358); NADPH specificity is not supported"),
 dict(aspect="MF",term="NADP binding (GO:0050661)",current_status="candidate",lead="do not add",
      rationale="cofactor pocket is open but the 2'-phosphate determinants are absent; if any cofactor term is used, NAD binding (GO:0051287) is the better-supported variant, still IEA-level"),
 dict(aspect="MF",term="NAD binding (GO:0051287)",current_status="candidate",lead="optional, low confidence lead",
      rationale="predicted from the charge-reversed 2'-phosphate site shared with NAD+-dependent L-GalDH; requires a binding assay"),
 dict(aspect="MF",term="potassium channel regulator activity (GO:0015459)",current_status="candidate",lead="do not add",
      rationale="MEC-14 is closer to L-GalDH (42.4%) than to any Kvbeta (max 31.5%); CDD assigns cd19163, not cd19141"),
 dict(aspect="BP",term="mechanosensory behavior / response to mechanical stimulus",current_status="supported by phenotype",
      lead="retain as non-core-mechanism BP from mutant phenotype (PMID 8692859)",rationale="phenotype is solid; mechanism is unknown"),
 dict(aspect="CC",term="cytoplasm",current_status="inferred",lead="treat as unverified",
      rationale="no localization experiment found for MEC-14; no signal peptide or TM segment in Q20127"),
])
go.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"go_decision_table.csv"),index=False)

cmp=pd.DataFrame([
 dict(feature="PF00248 identity to MEC-14 (%)",AKR1B1=23.2,Kvbeta2=27.1,Hyperkinetic=31.5,L_GalDH=42.4,MEC14=100.0),
 dict(feature="Tyr to 4th-position distance (A)",AKR1B1=3.70,Kvbeta2=5.32,Hyperkinetic=np.nan,L_GalDH=3.53,MEC14=5.08),
 dict(feature="4th tetrad residue",AKR1B1="His110",Kvbeta2="Asn158",Hyperkinetic="n/d",L_GalDH="His124",MEC14="Gln204"),
 dict(feature="2'-phosphate basic residues present",AKR1B1="yes (K262,R268)",Kvbeta2="no",Hyperkinetic="n/d",L_GalDH="no",MEC14="no (D354,Q358)"),
 dict(feature="Preferred cofactor",AKR1B1="NADPH",Kvbeta2="NADPH",Hyperkinetic="NADPH",L_GalDH="NAD+",MEC14="NAD(H) predicted"),
 dict(feature="C-terminal residues outside PF00248",AKR1B1=27,Kvbeta2=13,Hyperkinetic=17,L_GalDH=33,MEC14=80),
 dict(feature="N-terminal residues outside PF00248",AKR1B1=15,Kvbeta2=51,Hyperkinetic=62,L_GalDH=18,MEC14=96),
])
cmp.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"comparison_table.csv"),index=False)
print("\nWrote evidence_matrix.csv, go_decision_table.csv, comparison_table.csv, family_identity_summary.csv")

# ---------- final figure ----------
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(16,9))
ax1=plt.subplot2grid((2,3),(0,0),colspan=2)
top=r.head(16).iloc[::-1]
cols={"nematode AKR / MEC-14 clade":"#95a5a6","L-GalDH (EC 1.1.1.316)":"#c0392b",
      "AKR6 (Kv beta subunits)":"#2980b9","AKR1 (human/rat)":"#27ae60",
      "AKR7":"#8e44ad","bacterial / fungal / plant AKR":"#d4ac0d"}
ax1.barh(range(len(top)),top.pid,color=[cols[f] for f in top.family])
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(top))); ax1.set_yticklabels(top.protein,fontsize=8)
ax1.set_xlabel("% identity to MEC-14 over PF00248")
ax1.set_title("A. Closest characterised relative is L-galactose dehydrogenase (42.4%),\n11 points ahead of the nearest Kv beta subunit",fontsize=10)
for f,c in cols.items(): ax1.barh([],[],color=c,label=f)
ax1.legend(fontsize=7,loc="lower right")

ax2=plt.subplot2grid((2,3),(0,2))
X=np.arange(3); w=0.26
ax2.bar(X-w,[2.66,3.11,3.70],w,label="AKR1B1 1US0",color="#27ae60")
ax2.bar(X,[2.70,2.90,5.08],w,label="MEC-14 AF",color="#c0392b")
ax2.bar(X+w,[2.71,3.00,5.32],w,label="Kvbeta2 1QRQ",color="#2980b9")
ax2.set_xticks(X); ax2.set_xticklabels(["Asp-Lys","Lys-Tyr","Tyr-X4"],fontsize=8)
ax2.axhline(3.5,ls="--",c="k",lw=1); ax2.set_ylabel("tip-tip distance (A)",fontsize=8)
ax2.legend(fontsize=7); ax2.set_title("B. Relay intact, 4th position broken",fontsize=10)

ax3=plt.subplot2grid((2,3),(1,0))
lbl=["Y202","V203","Q204","I205","H206","D207"]; d=[10.83,8.86,0.93,9.76,5.76,11.37]
ax3.bar(lbl,d,color=["#c0392b" if x<3 else "#bdc3c7" for x in d]); ax3.axhline(3,ls="--",c="k",lw=1)
ax3.set_ylabel("dist. to L-GalDH His124 tip (A)",fontsize=8)
ax3.set_title("C. Gln204 occupies the catalytic-His site",fontsize=10); ax3.tick_params(labelsize=8)

ax4=plt.subplot2grid((2,3),(1,1))
pk=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"substrate_pocket_map.csv")); y=np.arange(len(pk))
ax4.barh(y,pk.ca_dev,color=["#2980b9" if v<3 else "#d35400" for v in pk.ca_dev])
ax4.set_yticks(y); ax4.set_yticklabels([f"{a}>{b}" for a,b in zip(pk.akr1b1,pk.mec14_by_struct)],fontsize=7)
ax4.axvline(3,ls="--",c="k",lw=1); ax4.invert_yaxis(); ax4.set_xlabel("CA deviation (A)",fontsize=8)
ax4.set_title("D. AKR1B1 substrate pocket onto MEC-14",fontsize=10)

ax5=plt.subplot2grid((2,3),(1,2))
od=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"pocket_ortholog_conservation.csv"))
cc=[c for c in od.columns if c not in ("acc","organism","pid")]
M=np.array([[1 if od[c].iloc[i]==c[0] else 0 for c in cc] for i in range(len(od))])
ax5.imshow(M,cmap="RdYlGn",vmin=0,vmax=1,aspect="auto")
ax5.set_xticks(range(len(cc))); ax5.set_xticklabels(cc,rotation=90,fontsize=7)
ax5.set_yticks(range(len(od))); ax5.set_yticklabels(od.organism.str[:22],fontsize=5)
ax5.set_title("E. 19 nematode orthologs:\nGln204 fixed, no His reversion",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
